entities.summary: Ivan Lutskievič Belarusian Museum in Vilnius is a Belarusian scientific and educational organisation, which originally existed from 1921 to 1945 in Vilnius. It was located in the Monastery of the Holy Trinity in close proximity to the Belarusian Scientific Society and Vilnius Belarusian Gymnasium. The museum was reestablished in 2001.
